# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| 1.0.x   | :white_check_mark: |
| < 1.0   | :x:                |

---

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability within this repository, please report it confidentially:

- **Security Contact:** Akash Chandra Das
- **Email:** [akashcdasbd@gmail.com](mailto:akashcdasbd@gmail.com)
- **Subject:** `[SECURITY REPORT] AI Email Automation Agent`

Please do not disclose security issues publicly until they have been reviewed and addressed.
